Hi, I’m Dr. Bimonte, The Non-Traditional Veterinarian®, a holistic/functional veterinarian with over 12 years of experience helping pets live better so they can live longer.

I created this channel to be the veterinarian your pet will thank you for™, sharing honest, practical insights on dog food, pet nutrition, gut health, longevity, and integrative veterinary care.

If you're tired of one-size-fits-all recommendations, overwhelmed by conflicting advice, or wondering if there's more to your pet's health than another prescription, you're in the right place!

Here you'll find:
• Pet nutrition and dog food guidance
• Integrative veterinary insights
• Wellness strategies for longevity
• Conversations about allergies, inflammation, and the microbiome
• A fresh perspective on pet health

My mission is simple: to help pet parents think differently, ask better questions, and become confident advocates for their pets.

Let's rethink pet care, together.
